# Lighthouse Dark - LLM Context File
# https://lighthousedark.org
# Last Updated: 2026-01-29

## About
Lighthouse Dark is a free, AI-powered web performance and SEO analysis tool. It provides blunt, witty critiques of websites' Core Web Vitals, SEO health, and performance metrics with actionable recommendations.

## Core Features
- **SEO Analysis**: Comprehensive audit of meta tags, headings, links, images, and content structure
- **Core Web Vitals**: LCP, FID, CLS, INP, TTFB, and FCP measurements using real Chrome UX Report (CrUX) data
- **Lighthouse Scores**: Performance, Accessibility, Best Practices, and SEO scores
- **AI-Powered Recommendations**: Intelligent suggestions for improving website performance
- **Real-Time Analysis**: Instant results with detailed breakdowns

## Technology Stack
- TanStack Start (React meta-framework)
- TanStack Router & Query
- Zustand for state management
- Tailwind CSS v4
- Cloudflare Workers deployment
- AI integration for smart recommendations

## API Endpoints
- `/api/og-image` - Dynamic Open Graph image generation
- Analysis endpoint (internal) - URL performance analysis

## Target Audience
- Web developers
- SEO specialists
- Digital marketers
- Site owners
- Performance engineers
- DevOps engineers
